verdict.rationale: AFK advertises integrations with a handful of named vendor tools (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe) plus vague 'and more', which supports some prebuilt connector capability, but there is no evidence of anything approaching a 'thousands of apps' ecosystem or marketplace typical of integration platforms. Missing for 10: a large documented connector catalog/marketplace, count of supported apps, evidence of breadth beyond ~4 named vendors, and any third-party corroboration of ecosystem scale.
